title: Analyze vulnerabilities to identify their root causes
reason: Every refusal, stop or defect is analyzed to its root cause: the incident record carries its case, class and design fix (scripts/incident, RV.3.1); the lessons registry keeps the causes over time and applies them to the process (RV.3.2, RV.3.4); the known-defect registry records a failure once by its normalized signature, so a second sighting joins the first, derives its unit and owner and opens its fix unit (RV.3.3); and the escape requirement measures what still reaches main. A vulnerability of our own code (VULN) goes through the same records.
